mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Run a syntax check on a class, program, CDS view or other object and see its errors and warnings.

description: [read-only] Runs a syntax check on the object named by object_type and object_name. object_type required: CLASS(object_name*), PROGRAM(object_name*) [onprem only], INTERFACE(object_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(object_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(object_name* as GROUP|MODULE), TABLE(object_name*), STRUCTURE(object_name*), DDL(object_name*), DOMAIN(object_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(object_name*), PACKAGE(object_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(object_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(object_name*). source_code checks unsaved source given in the call, for CLASS, STRUCTURE and DDL. Recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

object_name.description: Object name. A function module is named GROUP|MODULE, its function group first.

object_type.description: Object type. Supported: CLASS, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, PACKAGE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, METADATA_EXTENSION.

source_code.description: Source to check instead of the saved one; nothing is saved. CLASS, STRUCTURE and DDL only.

name: HandlerCheckRun
